summary:
Comprehensive Implementation Plan for Telegram Stars (XTR), Web Invoice, and TON Wallet Connect according to the 21.10.2026 specification.
Includes backend endpoints (/api/payments/stars/create, /api/payments/stars/create-link, /api/payments/stars/webhook, /api/me/subscription), TonConnectUI onStatusChange synchronization with auto-closing picker, shortened friendly address displays, full PRO modal states, and design/readability enhancements.
